value.title: Take a Copilot or OMP update
value.summary: Take a Copilot CLI or OMP update the governed way: update and run the contract check, decide when seats reload, audit with `just doctor`.

value.who: The prime, or a seat the operator asks.
value.when: When a new Copilot CLI or OMP version is out, or `just doctor` warns `copilot-sdk`. Run it with `--key <harness>-<version>`.

value.title: Update and check the harness
value.done_when: The update ran and its contract check passed (Copilot: update-copilot says the fleet may reload; OMP: omp-doctor passes).

value.title: Decide when seats reload
value.done_when: The prime picked when seats reload onto the new version; seats mid-turn wait.

value.title: Audit the installed surfaces
value.done_when: `just doctor` shows no copilot-sdk or OMP warning.

sections.name: done_when
sections.value: The harness is on the new version, its contract check passed, and the prime has said when seats reload.

value.text: Seats never update themselves (COPILOT_AUTO_UPDATE=false); a seat's version changes only when it relaunches onto the new binary.
Reloading seats after a failed contract check: the SDK may drop pij_send and the hooks (D-F208-2).
